description: Land Title settlement Dept - Kahatuduwa, Homagama D/S/D, Colombo District (25/55064)
categorisation: The gazette content is a "Notice Calling for Claims to Property of Intestate" under the Registration of Title Act. Its primary purpose is to facilitate the registration of land title for specific parcels of land (listed in schedules with cadastral details) following an intestate death. The entire notice deals with land ownership, claims, and the formal process of title registration, which fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4). It does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fall into other specialized non-land categories.
